source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check version of BMC/BIOS from BIOS
2. Send command to check version of BMC : ipmitool raw 0x30 0x20

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Command should be sent successfully
2. Versions should be shown correctly before and after flashing.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X GET https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/UpdateService/FirmwareInventory | jq .FirmwareInventory[]|select(.Name|test("RoT|Root of Trust"))
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return the FirmwareInventory entry matching RoT. No RISK.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: PACKAGE / IMPROVED; requires exact security-component mapping and separates version from attestation.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; entry 741/2291 covers the exact variant.

original_test_intent: Confirm the platform Root of Trust firmware version before and after a separate update; trust attestation is not stated as acceptance scope.
original_method: The item names RoT, but copied Procedure checks BMC/BIOS via raw IPMI; DeepSeek assumes a Redfish inventory and broad RoT name regex.
manual_activity: Security owner supplies the active RoT identity, approved version property and whether attestation is out of scope; version collection itself is automatable.
safety_requirements: Read only; do not update RoT, alter provisioning, reset or issue undocumented raw commands.
Do not infer active trust-anchor status from a matching name.
Use verified TLS and protected secrets.
Preserve complete responses; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Discover and query the approved active RoT version resource, compare exact values and collect security/BMC health evidence.
Do not claim attestation unless separately specified or issue the verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve active RoT mapping, expected versions and scope.
Resolve source wording and decide the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A broad inventory regex may return inactive or unrelated RoT-labelled components and assumes schema/TLS; it is not acceptance-ready.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use trusted discovery and the owner-approved active RoT member/property; keep version evidence distinct from attestation evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Copied raw IPMI method, script and 5/0-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the active RoT hardware/function to an authoritative read-only version field, collect complete evidence and compare to the approved release manifest; add attestation only as a separate approved scope.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform vendor RoT inventory and security documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds active-component identity and separates version from trust validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents a similarly named inactive device from satisfying the case.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Version equality alone does not prove a valid trust chain.

project_override_considerations: A project can add attestation coverage, but must not report it from name/version matching alone or silently replace the source's version scope.
expected_evidence: Active RoT identity and owner mapping
Complete inventory/member response and canonical version

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items require RoT version, while Procedure and Criteria describe BMC/BIOS and provide no RoT identity, version field or scope.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The named version intent is clear and can be automated after the security owner supplies a mapping; missing mapping/scope inputs do not make it permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects regex match as proof of the active RoT.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps component/scope controls while correcting PACKAGE to FULLY AUTOMATABLE under V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates version capability, readiness and optional attestation.

review_improvement: Prevents firmware-name matching from being reported as active Root-of-Trust validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: The core named task is a read-only version comparison, which software can perform once the active component is defined. The copied BMC/BIOS procedure is a source conflict; attestation must not be invented as acceptance scope.
